newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ Labour's Cullen to meet NZ First for talks.
newsitem.headline: NZ Labour's Cullen to meet NZ First for talks.

text.p: Labour finance spokesman Michael Cullen will meet negotiators from New Zealand First for a round of informal talks later on Monday, a Labour spokeswoman said.
The meeting had been in doubt because Labour leader Helen Clark is yet to return from Australia where she spent the weekend.

Nationalist New Zealand First holds the balance of power after the October 12 election and is negotiating separately with the conservative National Party caretaker government and centre-left Labour over the shape of the new governmnent.
The spokeswoman for Cullen could not list the other members of the Labour team who would be present, nor the time and venue of the meeting.

A spokeman for New Zealand First leader Winston Peters confirmed the meeting would be held later on Monday, but would not name a time or place. He said the meeting was informal and revealing the venue would provoke a media stake-out.
NZ First negotiators met Finance Minister Bill Birch for informal talks on Friday.
The next round of formal negotiations is set down for Tuesday. -- Wellington newsroom 64 4 473 4746
